indication: Previously untreated locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer

The choice between olaparib (OlympiAD) and talazoparib (EMBRACA) often comes down to hematologic-toxicity tolerance — talazoparib has higher anemia rates. intervention_dosing: 840 mg IV days 1, 15 + nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m^2 days 1, 8, 15 q28d

The trial enrolls advanced TNBC patients (including some 1L) and pre-specifies a MYC-amplified expansion; the patient's MYC-amp call is decision-relevant. Currently recruiting at NCI sites. The combination raises the bar for hematologic and neuropathy toxicity from nab-paclitaxel — not a veto for this patient (efficacy_toxicity_weight 0.7, no vetoes set).
intervention_dosing: ZEN-3694 oral daily + pembrolizumab 200 mg q3w + nab-paclitaxel 100 mg/m^2 days 1, 8, 15 q28d

Kept as a strategy template: induction with platinum-containing chemo (with or without pembrolizumab) followed by olaparib + durvalumab maintenance is a defensible off-trial regimen for this patient given her BRCA1 status and ICI-favorable phenotype.

Provides the rationale for a PARPi + ICI maintenance strategy after platinum-containing 1L induction, complementary to DORA and KEYLYNK-009.
intervention_dosing: Olaparib 300 mg PO BID + durvalumab 1500 mg IV q4w

Trial is completed and niraparib is not labeled in breast cancer in the US, so off-trial use is off-label and may have payer hurdles. Decision-relevant for the 2L maintenance design choice.

indication: Metastatic TNBC stratified by HRR mutation status

The patient's BRCA1 + TP53 + PTEN pattern fits the mechanistic hypothesis even though VIOLETTE was negative. Trial closed; included for the BRCA1+TP53 DDR-combination context.

Inavolisib is FDA-approved (Oct 2024) for HR+/HER2- + PIK3CA mut + endocrine-resistant breast cancer; off-label in TNBC. The result tempers the curative-intent framing for this patient, though biology-driven case-by-case consolidation discussions continue in tumor boards. Trial closed.

indication: Advanced or metastatic solid tumors with DDR-gene loss-of-function alterations

Enrollment turns on documented DDR-gene loss of function and ECOG 0-2, both of which the patient meets; the entity-anchored screen missed it because it searched named PARP drugs, not the POLQ gate. Not a 1L option since a washout from prior systemic therapy is expected, so it sits after her first line.

The NCI sponsorship and Polθ mechanism put it outside the named-drug search that produced the original rows.
